description: The Scaled Toadhawk is a strange hybrid creature found in swamps and forests. It has the body of a large toad, covered in rough scales, and the wings of a hawk, allowing it to glide silently between trees. Its long, sticky tongue can snatch small prey from a distance, while its sharp talons make it a dangerous predator in both air and on land.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The Scaled Toadhawk can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Silent Glide
traits.description: When flying, the Scaled Toadhawk can move without making a sound.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Scaled Toadhawk makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its talons.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tongue Snare
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the Scaled Toadhawk can't use its tongue on another target.
